analisis: Suplemento nutracéutico en cápsulas (frasco de 60) con aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, más vitaminas A y E. Ayuda a dar volumen a glúteos, piernas y caderas de forma natural. Se toman 2 cápsulas al día; lo ideal es el tratamiento de 3 frascos. Frasco negro mate con tapa y franja inferior fucsia y letras blancas grandes.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type.

datos.adicional: Es para el aumento de glúteo piernas y caderas de forma natural. Sus principales 3 extractos son los que dan los resultados (Aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra). Los antes y después deben ser bastantes visibles con respecto al volúmen en piernas y glúteos pero que se vea natural. shorts cortos como en las referencias subidas. Que las imagenes de las modelos tengan el mayor detalle de realismo

identidad_visual.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: glossy pink backgrounds, ultra-photorealistic women in short fitted shorts showing glutes, hips and legs, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable real-life results.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accents with small hearts, soft pink petal shapes and subtle bokeh in the background, real aguaje fruits with halved orange flesh as natural accents.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Poppins Bold (uppercase, heavy) for headlines and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, and a casual handwritten script for short emotional accents.
identidad_visual.art_direction: High-contrast pink-and-black look, the product always sharp and identical to the photo, women photographed with maximum realism (real skin texture, pores, natural light), visible but natural extra volume in glutes, hips and thighs.
